title: Lamsa's Better Carrot
description: A vanilla-friendly makeover for carrots, golden carrots and carrot on a stick.
body: # Lamsa's Better Carrot Part of the **Lamsa's Better** series. ## Features Lamsa's Better Carrot is a small vanilla-friendly resource pack that improves the appearance of carrots while staying true to Minecraft's original art style. This resource pack redesigns: - Carrot - Golden Carrot - Carrot on a Stick The goal of the **Lamsa's Better** series is to improve Minecraft's textures while preserving the original vanilla style. ## Screenshots Preview images can be found in the **Gallery** section of this project page. ## Feedback Found a bug, visual issue, or have a suggestion? Feel free to share your feedback. Every report and suggestion helps improve future updates. ## Support My Work If you enjoy this resource pack and would like to support future projects: ☕ **Ko-fi:** ## Follow Me Stay updated with future releases:
